name: e-comm — Block 4: A location slips, the dashboard catches it
initialPrompt: The next time one of your locations starts slipping, the dashboard catches it. You see the trend before it lands in the monthly review, and you know whether it's a competitor winning on value, a sentiment shift, or something operational before it costs you the location.
